summary: legal checked in 6 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; keep private. Evidence shows Woot’s public terms do not establish rights to collect, derive, store, cache, publicly display, or alert on deal data, and no written permission is evidenced. Accuracy/freshness, security, measurement, attribution, privacy, and owner gates also remain incomplete. Ordinary fleet growth is not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry, but no unsupported revenue, ROI, margin, or causal claims are cleared. Exact decision: authorize only bounded read-only evidence work and internal draft preparation; do not expose publicly, expand alerts, send external outreach, change credentials/configuration, deploy, or spend. Next evidence action: prepare a draft Woot permission request and attach a field-level rights matrix; do not send it without owner approval and human counsel review.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. Progress: the checklist, public Woot documentation, public terms, repository data-flow files, privacy/cookie pages, and draft terms are evidenced; no legal or technical launch task is closed because required permission, retention/deletion, consent configuration, vendor, security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner evidence is incomplete. Next evidence actions are task-specific: obtain a current Woot permission record; produce the alert-data retention/deletion table; capture deployed consent and GA4 settings; and inventory logs, vendors, and incident/request procedures.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked because public terms conflict with the proposed public/commercial use and no written permission or field-level rights are evidenced. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed because retention, deletion, access, correction, processor, consent, and unsubscribe evidence is missing. GA4 is evidence_needed because deployed consent behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention, and jurisdiction-specific review are not evidenced. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed because log fields, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures are not evidenced. Human counsel is required before relying on any permission, affiliate/advertising use, sensitive-data processing, or jurisdictional conclusion.

Compliance evidence is a technical baseline, not certification: 37 sites pass, 16 fail, and 6 are unknown; open findings include banner, consent accept/reject, GA4, privacy, and terms gaps. SearchWoot’s private gate is therefore concrete and remains unchanged. Affiliate attribution evidence is partial aggregate: $4.92 is unattributed, site-attributed income is $0, and no revenue, ROI, margin, or causal-lift claim is cleared.

No go-live proposal is retained. No evidence supports implementation.launch_gate="go_live" or legal_review.status="approved". Human counsel is required for upstream data rights, public redistribution, affiliate or advertising expansion, privacy jurisdiction treatment, and any regulated or age-sensitive use that is not specifically evidenced.

items.summary: Retain only as bounded report-only evidence work. It may document source rights, data flows, consent, vendors, retention, correction, takedown, security, attribution, and launch blockers from existing artifacts. It must not send permission requests, expose the product, expand alerts, change configuration, deploy, spend, or make legal-certification claims.
